description: This file contains initialization code for the NXP i.MX8M Lite M7 SoC, including RDC (Reset Domain Controller) and clock setup functions, configuration constants for PLLs, and system initialization routines.

methods.name: SOC_RdcInit
methods.description: Initializes the RDC by assigning the M7 core to a specific domain and enabling clocks for various peripherals.

methods.name: SOC_ClockInit
methods.description: Configures system clocks and PLLs for the M7 core, including switching root muxes and setting dividers.

methods.name: nxp_mimx8ml8_init
methods.description: Main system initialization function that sets up RDC and clocks during system startup.
